articles.headline: Stop illegal detentions, says SC amid crackdown in Delhi
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court directed the Centre and Delhi Police to ensure free movement of people subject to law and public order amid a crackdown on protests, with counsel calling Saturday’s conditions a step away from a police state; the court held a special hearing on detentions and barricades. Krishnadas Rajagopal reports from New Delhi.

articles.headline: Modi government has imposed an ‘undeclared Emergency’: Kharge
articles.blurb: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, speaking in Kalaburagi, accused the Union government of imposing an undeclared Emergency over detention of protesters and linked the unrest to demands for accountability from the Chief Election Commissioner.

articles.headline: Journalists, youth held as protest against CEC continues
articles.blurb: Police in New Delhi detained journalists and young protesters as demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the special intensive revision of electoral rolls continued, report Lekpreet Kaur, Nikhila M. Babu and bureau staff.

articles.headline: 11-day Dasara festivities begin in Mysuru
articles.blurb: Dasara celebrations opened in Mysuru with the palace illuminated and Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and other dignitaries attending inaugural events; festivities are scheduled across 11 days with cultural programmes centred on the palace.

articles.headline: SIR: Death certificates used to seek deletion of similar names of living voters
articles.blurb: In Belagavi, investigators found death certificates being used in Form 7 objections to remove living voters with similar names from rolls; the report ties large batches of objections to a BJP leader, Basanagouda R. Patil Yatnal.

articles.headline: 8,000 Philately Passports sold in a matter of few hours across Karnataka
articles.blurb: India Post sold about 8,000 commemorative Philately Passports within hours at general post offices in Bengaluru, Mangaluru and Belagavi after the new passport-style philately product was offered to collectors.

articles.headline: Cong. leaders to join Delhi protest
articles.blurb: Karnataka Congress leaders prepared to travel to New Delhi to join protests over electoral roll revision and the conduct of the Election Commission, the NEARBY brief reports.

articles.headline: Drought hits mulberry yield
articles.blurb: A front-page brief notes drought stress on mulberry cultivation affecting sericulture, pointing to coverage inside on yield loss and cocoon prices.

articles.headline: Khader asks officials to prepare presentation ahead of High Court panel's visit
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada in-charge Minister U.T. Khader asked Deputy Commissioner H.V. Darshan to ready a checklist of infrastructure needed for a permanent High Court bench as a three-member judicial panel visits Mangaluru; he said Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar supports the bench.

articles.headline: KSRTC operates 25 buses under 10-day Dasara Darshan tour package
articles.blurb: KSRTC ran 25 buses on a 10-day Dasara Darshan package from Mangaluru and Udupi to temples across the region, using BS-VI fleet buses; 1,028 passengers travelled on the first day.

articles.headline: SWR to run special train to Delhi today
articles.blurb: South Western Railway will operate a one-way unreserved express special from Mangaluru Central to Shakur Basti, Delhi, today to clear extra passenger rush.

articles.headline: Dasara celebrations begin; CM postpones visit to Mangaluru and Udupi
articles.blurb: Navaratri began along the coast with Kudroli Gokarnanatha Temple events and traditional Huli Vesha performances; Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar postponed a scheduled visit to Mangaluru and Udupi.

articles.headline: MAHE V-C Ramdas Pai gets FICCI award
articles.blurb: Manipal Academy of Higher Education chancellor Dr. Ramdas M. Pai received the FICCI Legendary Institution Builder Award 2020 at a ceremony where former Union Minister Murali Manohar Joshi presented the honour.

articles.headline: Volunteers clean Central Railway Station Road
articles.blurb: Swachh Mangaluru Abhiyan volunteers cleaned and painted walls along Central Railway Station Road on Sunday as part of a civic cleanliness drive.

articles.headline: MAHE observes Hospice and Palliative Care Day
articles.blurb: MAHE marked Hospice and Palliative Care Day with a “run and ride for dignity” awareness event organised by the Mookambika Hospice and Respite Centre.

articles.headline: ₹2,459-cr. Ponzi scheme: ED files prosecution complaint
articles.blurb: The Enforcement Directorate filed a prosecution complaint before the III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mangaluru, on Friday seeking conviction of Shivananda, associates and M/s Shivan Associates in a ₹2,459-crore money laundering case linked to a Ponzi scheme probed after a Malappuram police FIR.

articles.headline: VTU offers minor degrees for skill enhancement
articles.blurb: Visvesvaraya Technological University is offering minor degrees in five areas including artificial intelligence and machine learning for engineering students enrolled in affiliated colleges to add skills and entrepreneurial options.

articles.headline: Cong. leaders walk out of event over full Vande Mataram rendition
articles.blurb: Congress leaders including H.C. Yogesh walked out of Shivamogga’s Dasara inaugural on Sunday when the full Vande Mataram was sung, saying State instructions limit official programmes to the first two stanzas.

articles.headline: Construction labourer killed over ₹600 dispute in Bengaluru; one arrested
articles.blurb: A dispute over ₹600 led to the killing of construction worker Manjunatha in Bengaluru; police arrested colleague Palani, who allegedly struck him with a wooden stick.

articles.headline: CM, Cong. legislators to join protest against SIR in Delhi today
articles.blurb: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and ruling Congress legislators left for New Delhi to protest at the Election Commission, demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged electoral roll irregularities and the SIR exercise.

articles.headline: Silk smitten: Drought hits mulberry yield
articles.blurb: About half of Karnataka’s mulberry yield has been hit by drought and mite attacks, affecting sericulture in Chikkaballapura, Kolar, Ramanagara and Mandya districts where more than one lakh hectares are under mulberry.

articles.headline: Prices of silk cocoons shoot up
articles.blurb: Joint Director of Sericulture Mallikarjun Swamy said cocoon prices touched a record ₹820 per kg, helping farmers but worrying private reelers.

articles.headline: HDK questions Shivakumar’s silence on sting operation, seeks probe
articles.blurb: Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy questioned Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar’s silence on an alleged sting involving five Cabinet Ministers and demanded a thorough probe.

articles.headline: Time will give reply: CM
articles.blurb: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar gave a brief response to Kumaraswamy’s allegations on the sting operation, saying time would provide the answer.

articles.headline: BJP to lay siege to police stations
articles.blurb: BJP State president B.Y. Vijayendra said the party would protest at police stations and SP offices against “false” FIRs filed over the SIR exercise.

articles.headline: Make evidence public
articles.blurb: The Corridors of Power column notes the verbal duel between Shivakumar and Kumaraswamy over the sting operation and calls for evidence to be made public.

articles.headline: Meal disruptions
articles.blurb: A brief reports disruption of food grants for SC/ST students in hostels.

articles.headline: SUDA chief changes
articles.blurb: C.G. Madhusudan has been appointed chairman of the Shivamogga-Bhadravathi Urban Development Authority, the column notes.

articles.headline: 29,000 forms seeking SIR deletions in Karnataka not available on portals of ECI
articles.blurb: While Karnataka’s CEO said 1,10,654 Form 7 applications were received by October 8, only 81,822 appear on Election Commission portals, leaving about 29,000 deletion requests without public scrutiny details, report Rishita Khanna and Pon Vasanth B.A.

articles.headline: Death certificates used to seek removal of those with similar names
articles.blurb: Continuing a front-page story, the report cites teacher Allama Bagwan being falsely declared dead to remove her from rolls and notes nearly 20,000 objections in Vijayapura city largely targeting Muslim names.

articles.headline: Rights and wrongs
articles.blurb: The editorial argues the government must not damp down dissent and protest, stressing constitutional rights to peaceable assembly.

articles.headline: Message of peace
articles.blurb: The editorial welcomes the Nobel Committee awarding South African jurist Navi Pillay the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize.

articles.headline: Changing the guard, confronting the democratic crisis
articles.blurb: Mehbooba Mufti writes that weakened institutional safeguards around the Election Commission and the new Chief Election Commissioner deepen India’s democratic crisis.

articles.headline: Barricades cannot silence the voice of democracy
articles.blurb: CPI(M) general secretary M.A. Baby argues shrinking protest spaces and laws such as the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita require citizens to defend the right to dissent.

articles.headline: Electoral transparency
articles.blurb: M. Jameel Ahmed of Mysuru, in a letter, urges greater transparency in electoral processes.

articles.headline: Letter on civic duty
articles.blurb: Thancius S. Fernando of Chennai contributes a letter to the editor on public responsibility.

articles.headline: The need to preserve the shine of Indian elections
articles.blurb: Former ECI director general Akshay Rout argues elections must remain credible amid SIR controversies, judicial oversight and executive pressure, with security deployed outside the Commission ahead of protests.

articles.headline: The gaps in the implementation of the RTI Act
articles.blurb: Sneha Gandha, Gauri Singavarapu and Sachin Swaraj show voluntary Section 4 disclosures remain poor, with many public authorities failing transparency audits despite rising RTI requests.

articles.headline: Rahul urges citizens to join INDIA march to top court
articles.blurb: Rahul Gandhi invited everyone who believes in democracy to join an INDIA bloc march to the Supreme Court; K.C. Venugopal accused Delhi Police of turning the capital into a “torture chamber,” Sandeep Phukan reports.

articles.headline: Stop illegal detentions, says SC amid crackdown
articles.blurb: From page one: the Supreme Court heard urgent pleas on illegal detentions during the Delhi crackdown, with justices citing flagrant violations and Solicitor General Tushar Mehta defending police action.

articles.headline: Hindu outfit backs its men arrested over Delhi assault
articles.blurb: Delhi Police arrested four men for assaulting a protester and a woman; Hindu outfit leader Pinky Chaudhary said the accused belonged to his organisation, Luvpreet Kaur reports.

articles.headline: CJI declines request by Rahul for meeting today
articles.blurb: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant declined Rahul Gandhi’s request for a meeting, saying the matters he wished to discuss are sub judice.

articles.headline: Detained protesters accuse Mumbai Police of using ‘excessive force’
articles.blurb: Citizens for Justice and Peace workers alleged disproportionate force when Mumbai police detained protesters at Shivaji Park on Sunday, Yohann Varughese reports.

articles.headline: Journalists, youth held as protest continues
articles.blurb: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das report detentions of journalists and SFI activists near Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar during continuing anti-CEC protests.

articles.headline: How the Mahatma’s court statement in 1922 echoes amid Delhi detentions
articles.blurb: Krishnadas Rajagopal compares current detention debates with Mahatma Gandhi’s 1922 sedition trial and Article 19 protections.

articles.headline: Offered help to Dipke after grandmother’s death: Delhi Police
articles.blurb: Delhi Police said they offered detained activist Abhijeet Dipke help to travel after his grandmother’s death, disputing claims they blocked him from attending funeral rites.

articles.headline: Sporadic protests break uneasy calm in capital
articles.blurb: Despite heavy deployments, protests continued in New Delhi on Sunday with hundreds detained including Rajya Sabha member John Brittas and AISA leader Neha Bora at Connaught Place, Lavpreet Kaur reports.

articles.headline: Protests will go on across the country till CEC resigns: CJP
articles.blurb: Cockroach Janta Party conveners Ashutosh Ranke and Saurav Das said demonstrations would continue until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns and alleged police seized phones.

articles.headline: Protesters and journalists allege getting roughed up; police defend their actions
articles.blurb: About a dozen journalists and many protesters alleged manhandling by Delhi Police while police said force was needed against non-cooperative crowds, Lavpreet Kaur reports.

articles.headline: DYFI to move SC over ‘illegal detention’ of its activists
articles.blurb: The Democratic Youth Federation of India will approach the Supreme Court over alleged illegal detention and custodial torture of activists including MP A.A. Rahim.

articles.headline: Police turned Delhi into a war zone, says Left; MP hospitalised
articles.blurb: Left parties condemned police action; CPI(M) MP John Brittas was admitted to Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital after being dragged into a police van.

articles.headline: Manipur CM calls for peace as clashes leave nine dead
articles.blurb: Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh directed authorities to control violence after nine deaths in two days of Kuki-Naga clashes; over 50 have died in such fighting since February, bureau reports from Guwahati.

articles.headline: Mizoram to count refugees separately during 2027 Census
articles.blurb: Mizoram will enumerate refugees from Myanmar and Bangladesh separately from Indian citizens in the next census phase, Home Minister K. Sapdanga said.

articles.headline: Musk can't pressure India on Starlink, says House panel chief
articles.blurb: Parliamentary Standing Committee on IT chairman Nishikant Dubey said Elon Musk cannot pressure India on Starlink clearance amid security concerns.

articles.headline: Appointment of new Deputy Election Commissioner puts ECI work hierarchy in focus
articles.blurb: IAS officer Prakash Rajpurohit’s appointment as Deputy Election Commissioner highlights how responsibilities are shared within the Election Commission, Sreeparna Chakrabarty writes.

articles.headline: Indo-French satellite set for launch in '12-16 months'
articles.blurb: ISRO and France’s CNES expect to launch the TRISHNA thermal infrared earth observation satellite in 12–16 months.

articles.headline: Mamata AITC MLA attacked; Abhishek served police notice
articles.blurb: An AITC MLA was attacked in West Bengal while Abhishek Banerjee received a police notice, a brief reports.

articles.headline: Two die of gas exposure at ESL steel plant in Jharkhand
articles.blurb: Two workers died from gas exposure at ESL Steel Limited in Bokaro district.

articles.headline: Delhi High Court acquits man convicted in POCSO case
articles.blurb: The Delhi High Court set aside a 20-year POCSO conviction citing material contradictions in testimony.

articles.headline: IIIT-Ranchi student found dead in hostel, protest erupts
articles.blurb: A first-year student was found dead in an IIIT-Ranchi hostel, triggering student protests.

articles.headline: 'Excess': More to pay, not more to receive
articles.blurb: K. Nitya Kalyani explains insurance “excess” or deductibles—the out-of-pocket amount before claims pay—and how voluntary higher excess can cut premiums.

articles.headline: When our meandering money leaves a mark
articles.blurb: Sincy Wilson and Vaishali R. Venkat warn that digital transaction trails expose personal habits and discuss privacy under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

articles.headline: Investing in sector and thematic funds
articles.blurb: Venkatesh Bangaruswamy advises using sectoral and thematic mutual funds sparingly within a core-satellite portfolio because they concentrate industry risk.

articles.headline: Shooting leaves 9 dead including suspect in Pennsylvania, police say
articles.blurb: Police in Concord, Pennsylvania, said a shooting left nine dead including a suspect.

articles.headline: Nepal flash floods sweep away houses, five people missing
articles.blurb: Flash floods in Nepal destroyed houses and left five people missing, Kathmandu reports said.

articles.headline: 11 killed, 27 hurt as coach crashes into truck in Turkey: authorities
articles.blurb: A coach crash into a truck in Turkey killed 11 people and injured 27, authorities in Istanbul said.

articles.headline: 139 migrants dead, 84 missing as boat capsizes off Djibouti: UN
articles.blurb: The UN said 139 migrants died and 84 were missing after a boat capsized off Djibouti.

articles.headline: Riyadh airport struck again a day after 12 killed in Houthi escalation
articles.blurb: A fresh strike hit Riyadh’s airport area as Saturday’s attacks wounded about 300 and kept the airport closed; India’s embassy reported one citizen killed and at least 10 injured as Donald Trump said he would speak to Saudi Arabia’s crown prince.

articles.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree to ‘energy ceasefire’: Trump
articles.blurb: Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed an energy ceasefire while Volodymyr Zelenskyy described it as an energy security arrangement, Associated Press reports from Washington.

articles.headline: India acknowledged Katchatheevu is ours, says Sri Lankan PM
articles.blurb: Sri Lankan Prime Minister said India has acknowledged Katchatheevu belongs to Sri Lanka, Meera Srinivasan reports from Colombo.

articles.headline: Pakistan declares emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, suspends provincial govt.
articles.blurb: Pakistan imposed emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and suspended the provincial government, PTI reports from Islamabad.

articles.headline: Brazil’s Lula accuses Meta of interference in country’s elections
articles.blurb: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva accused Meta of interfering in Brazilian elections, AFP reports from Brasilia.

articles.headline: Ankita, Venkatram set meet records
articles.blurb: At the National Open athletics in New Delhi, Ankita Dhyani broke a 15-year women’s 3000m steeplechase record and Magali Venkatram Reddy set a meet record in the men’s 800m, Uthra Ganesan reports.

articles.headline: India women suffer heavy defeat to Russia
articles.blurb: India’s women’s football team lost 0-8 to Russia in an international friendly in Kolkata.

articles.headline: Shedge gives India-A victory
articles.blurb: Shedge’s 82 helped India-A beat Australia-A in Puducherry, Anish Pathiyil reports.

articles.headline: Abhishek, Arshdeep shine as India wins a run-fest
articles.blurb: India beat West Indies by 14 runs in the third T20I at Indore—223 for six to 209 for seven—with Abhishek Sharma scoring 69 off 30 and Arshdeep Singh taking three wickets to lead the series 2-1.

articles.headline: Abhishek reaches the 2000-run milestone in least number of balls
articles.blurb: Abhishek Sharma reached 2,000 international runs in 1,024 balls, the fastest to the mark in the format cited.

articles.headline: Smith breaks record for the most catches by a fielder in Tests
articles.blurb: Steve Smith took his 211th Test catch against South Africa at Kingsmead, surpassing David Bedingham as the leading Test fielder.

articles.headline: Pacer Mahmud’s hat-trick puts Bangladesh in command
articles.blurb: Hasan Mahmud’s hat-trick left Bangladesh ahead of Afghanistan in their one-off Test.

articles.headline: Farhan, Sadaqat star in Pakistan’s easy victory against Sri Lanka
articles.blurb: Pakistan beat Sri Lanka by 82 runs in the second T20I in Rawalpindi.

articles.headline: Bowlers hand Australia the advantage
articles.blurb: Australia led South Africa by 139 runs after day three of the Durban Test as bowlers dominated.

articles.headline: Archers too hot for Knights; Yodhas lord over Chiefs, Marathas pip Royals
articles.blurb: Archery league results in Hyderabad saw Cheru Archers, Yodhas and Marathas win their fixtures, Anirudh Velamuri reports.

articles.headline: Verstappen finally wins the Singapore GP
articles.blurb: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole, his first victory at Marina Bay, AFP reports.

articles.headline: City routs Liverpool
articles.blurb: Manchester City beat Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield in the Premier League, AFP reports from Liverpool.

articles.headline: Smriti named UNICEF India celebrity advocate
articles.blurb: Cricketer Smriti Mandhana was named a UNICEF India celebrity advocate for girls’ rights and sport.

articles.headline: Arunachal forfeits Ranji game against Nagaland
articles.blurb: Arunachal Pradesh forfeited its Ranji Trophy Plate Group match against Nagaland for failing to field a team.

articles.headline: India U-17 women enter Asian Cup second time running
articles.blurb: India’s under-17 women qualified for the 2027 AFC U-17 Women’s Asian Cup in China after beating Malaysia 3-0.

articles.headline: Udhayveer claims 10m air pistol gold at Cairo ISSF WC
articles.blurb: Udhayveer Sidhu won 10m air pistol gold at the ISSF World Cup in Cairo.

articles.headline: Dasara Sports CM Cup inaugurated
articles.blurb: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara inaugurated the Dasara Sports CM Cup 2026 at Chamundivihar Indoor Stadium in Mysuru.

articles.headline: Smaran digs in to bail Karnataka out from a precarious position
articles.blurb: Karnataka captain Smaran made an unbeaten 126 in nearly five and a half hours as the visitors reached 274 for four on day one of the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy opener against Andhra in Vijayawada after slipping to 22 for four.

articles.headline: I am just staying in the present, says Smaran
articles.blurb: Karnataka skipper Smaran said he was focusing on the present after his rescue act against Andhra, N. Sudarshan reports from Vijayawada.

articles.headline: Blasters blank Kashi, begin with a bang
articles.blurb: Kerala Blasters beat Inter Kashi 2-0 in Pune on ISL opening night with goals from Vibin Mohan and Hamed Sinan.

articles.headline: Memorable day for Gutte and Ishaan
articles.blurb: Krishna Gutte and Ishaan Madesh won races at the MRF National Racing Championship at Madras International Circuit.

articles.headline: No 'slow learners'
articles.blurb: Albert P’Rayan argues teachers should adapt to diverse learning styles instead of labelling students “slow learners,” citing examples of late-blooming achievers.

articles.headline: Infocepts Innovate for Impact Scholarship
articles.blurb: Infocepts Foundation offers up to ₹50,000 a year for four years to UG students in select cities studying computer engineering, IT, AI, ML or data science; deadline October 30.

articles.headline: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Transgender Scholarship
articles.blurb: Ujjivan SFB scholarship gives up to ₹40,000 for transgender students in secondary through postgraduate courses; deadline October 30.

articles.headline: Aditya Birla Capital Scholarship
articles.blurb: Meritorious students in Classes 9–12 or diploma, UG and PG courses can apply for the Aditya Birla Capital scholarship programme.

articles.headline: Reimagine Ideathon 2.0
articles.blurb: CDSL invites student teams to propose fintech and cyber-safety solutions; eligible teams need four students and a faculty mentor with applications due October 30 at ideathon.cdslindia.com.

articles.headline: My Olympics preparation is not going to change much
articles.blurb: Golfer Pranavi Urs told Nihit Sachdeva her Asian Games gold and team silver in Aichi-Nagoya and experience on the Ladies European Tour shape her steady Olympic build-up for 2028.

articles.headline: Global warming is turning sex reversal in frogs into extinction risk
articles.blurb: Rajay Khurana reports Hungarian research in Science Advances showing heatwaves can turn genetic female agile frogs into functional males, skewing sex ratios and raising extinction risk within decades.

articles.headline: Jonathan, world's oldest known land animal
articles.blurb: Scientists study 184-year-old Aldabra giant tortoise Jonathan on St. Helena to understand extreme longevity.

articles.headline: Type I and type II errors
articles.blurb: Vasudevan Mukunth explains false positives and false negatives in statistics, using electoral roll clean-up as an example of trade-offs.

articles.headline: Number of FIRs registered by Delhi Police over CJP protest
articles.blurb: Delhi Police registered 20 FIRs over the Cockroach Janta Party protest demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, detaining more than 7,000 people with over 30,000 personnel deployed, PTI reports.

articles.headline: FDI inflows this quarter from India's largest source, Japan
articles.blurb: Japan invested $5.71 billion in India in April–June 2026-27, surpassing the $3.74 billion received from Japan in all of 2025-26, government data show.

articles.headline: Maximum temperature levels recorded in the national capital
articles.blurb: Delhi recorded a maximum of 32°C on Sunday, 2.2 notches below normal, and a minimum of 24.4°C, 1.4 notches above normal, IMD data show.

articles.headline: Number of migrants dead in Djibouti boat accident
articles.blurb: At least 109 migrants died and 116 remain missing after a boat carrying 305 people capsized off Djibouti on October 8-9; about 80 survived, a UN agency said.

articles.headline: Number of people who died in U.S. Cyclone Isaias
articles.blurb: Hurricane Isaias, the first U.S. mainland hurricane since 2024, was linked to at least four deaths and left nearly 700,000 customers without power, AFP reports.

articles.headline: Why UAPA demands urgent reform
articles.blurb: Gautam Bhatia argues vague UAPA membership clauses and strict bail rules have jailed activists, scholars and journalists for years without trial, citing G.N. Saibaba’s decade in prison and Bhima Koregaon and Delhi riots cases.

articles.headline: Why is Norway considering a temporary smart glasses ban?
articles.blurb: Haider Ali Khan reports Norway may temporarily restrict smart glasses in schools, playgrounds and healthcare settings over covert recording and facial recognition, while Meta paused some European sales pending clarity.
